name: Braised Leeks with Rosemary, Lemon Zest & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small pkg fresh rosemary
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Place in a large baking dish, cut-side up, and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet or braising pan (12-inches or larger) over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add 2 tbsp butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add half of the leeks to the skillet, cut-side down (arranging them in a single layer). Cook, turning once, until golden, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the baking dish, then repeat with remaining butter and leeks.
Meanwhile, slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves.

When the second batch of leeks is done, return all leeks to the skillet or braising pan, turning them on their sides (if necessary) and nestling them together to fit. (Reserve baking dish for later use.)

Add rosemary and broth to the skillet (add more broth, if necessary, so that the leeks are just submerged), then bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a rapid simmer and cook, uncovered, until leeks can be easily pierced with a knife and liquid has reduced, about 25 minutes. (There will still be some liquid in the skillet.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl.
Zest lemon into the bowl with the Parmesan, then stir to combine. (Reserve lemon for another use.)
Grease the reserved baking dish with butter.
When the leeks are almost done, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

When the leeks are done, using tongs, transfer to the baking dish, gently shaking off any excess liquid. Arrange leeks so that the cut-side is facing up, then sprinkle with the lemon-Parmesan mixture.
Place baking dish in the oven and broil until cheese is golden and melted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Transfer leeks to a serving platter, share, and enjoy!
